nodes.label: Onboarding Hero Image
nodes.description: Black-and-white high-contrast gym training photograph showing a group of athletes (foreground: a focused woman in athletic wear, mid-ground: a man) performing overhead barbell squats or snatch-movement exercises in a crossfit-style gym with gymnastic rings and industrial ceiling visible in the background. The image communicates intensity, discipline, and collective effort. Emotional tone is motivational and empowering — serious, determined expressions paired with peak physical exertion. Used as the hero/background image on the GetStarted onboarding screen to inspire new users to begin their fitness journey, reinforcing the app's identity as a serious AI-powered personal training assistant.
nodes.visual_activity: overhead barbell squat / crossfit group class
nodes.onboarding_purpose: Welcome/GetStarted screen hero image; motivates new users to start their personalised training plan
